sentences.en: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!
sentences.zh: 我父母总是为一些愚蠢的事情争吵。真让人恼火！

sentences.en: Anything that is too stupid to be spoken is sung.
sentences.zh: 太蠢说不出口的东西就唱出来。

sentences.en: Most people think that gorillas are stupid. Is that true?
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为大猩猩很笨。这是真的吗？
